mapper.select: SELECT * FROM biz_sale_record WHERE record_no = #{recordNo} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM biz_sale_record WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT sr.id, sr.record_no, sr.business_date, sr.platform, sr.platform_order_no, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT p.product_name ORDER BY p.product_name SEPARATOR '、') AS product_name, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT pu.purchase_no ORDER BY pu.purchase_no SEPARATOR '、') AS purchase_no, sr.buyer_name, sr.buyer_phone, COALESCE(SUM(si.quantity), 0) AS item_count, sr.total_sale_amount, sr.total_cost_amount, sr.received_amount, sr.profit_amount, sr.payment_status, sr.shipment_status, sr.express_company, sr.express_no, sr.remark, sr.created_at FROM biz_sale_record sr LEFT JOIN biz_sale_item si ON si.sale_record_id = sr.id AND si.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN biz_product p ON p.id = si.product_id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN biz_purchase pu ON pu.id = si.purchase_id AND pu.deleted = 0
GROUP BY sr.id, sr.record_no, sr.business_date, sr.platform, sr.platform_order_no, sr.buyer_name, sr.buyer_phone, sr.total_sale_amount, sr.total_cost_amount, sr.received_amount, sr.profit_amount, sr.payment_status, sr.shipment_status, sr.express_company, sr.express_no, sr.remark, sr.created_at ORDER BY sr.business_date DESC, sr.id DESC

SELECT COUNT(1) AS orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(t.total_sale_amount), 0) AS totalSaleAmount, COALESCE(SUM(t.profit_amount), 0) AS totalProfitAmount FROM ( SELECT sr.id, sr.total_sale_amount, sr.profit_amount FROM biz_sale_record sr LEFT JOIN biz_sale_item si ON si.sale_record_id = sr.id AND si.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN biz_product p ON p.id = si.product_id AND p.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN biz_purchase pu ON pu.id = si.purchase_id AND pu.deleted = 0
GROUP BY sr.id, sr.total_sale_amount, sr.profit_amount ) t
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO biz_sale_record ( record_no, business_date, platform, platform_order_no, buyer_name, buyer_phone, total_sale_amount, total_cost_amount, platform_fee, express_fee, package_fee, promotion_fee, refund_amount, other_expense, received_amount, profit_amount, payment_status, shipment_status, express_company, express_no, remark, created_at, updated_at, deleted ) VALUES ( #{recordNo}, #{businessDate}, #{platform}, #{platformOrderNo}, #{buyerName}, #{buyerPhone}, #{totalSaleAmount}, #{totalCostAmount}, #{platformFee}, #{expressFee}, #{packageFee}, #{promotionFee}, #{refundAmount}, #{otherExpense}, #{receivedAmount}, #{profitAmount}, #{paymentStatus}, #{shipmentStatus}, #{expressCompany}, #{expressNo}, #{remark}, NOW(), NOW(), 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE biz_sale_record SET total_sale_amount = #{totalSaleAmount}, total_cost_amount = #{totalCostAmount}, received_amount = #{receivedAmount}, profit_amount = #{profitAmount}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

UPDATE biz_sale_record SET business_date = #{businessDate}, platform = #{platform}, platform_order_no = #{platformOrderNo}, buyer_name = #{buyerName}, buyer_phone = #{buyerPhone}, payment_status = #{paymentStatus}, shipment_status = #{shipmentStatus}, express_company = #{expressCompany}, express_no = #{expressNo}, remark = #{remark}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
